notes.title: The Flower Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Time is Honey v1.6 Patch Notes and The Flower Update[/h1]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] The old upgrade system has been removed and replaced with a new [b]Flower Pot & Flower system[/b].  
[*] Flowers give different effects like boosting honey, XP, or chances of opening a golden bee in a pack...  
[*] Pots multiply the effects of planted flowers in different ways.  
[*] When you load your old save, all honey spent on previous upgrades will be refunded so you can reinvest into flowers.  
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hive backgrounds are now slightly blurred for a nicer sense of depth and perspective.  
[*] Shop items are now sorted by price (low -> high).  
[*] Added a purchase confirmation dialog in the shop to prevent accidental buys.  
[*] After editing a sticker, the game now automatically reopens the shop so you can quickly buy more.  
[*] Added a small info box that shows your hive’s current honey per hour.  
[*] Added a new shader to the cards.  
[*] Next button in the tutorial has been moved from left to the right.  
[*] In the “Found Accessories” screen, hovering an accessory now shows which packs it can be found in.  
[*] Game now creates a backup of your save every time you load the game (stored in the [i]save/backup[/i] folder).  
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Korean, Chinese, and Japanese fonts sometimes not rendering.  
[*] Fixed: Idle bees not always gaining XP correctly.  
[*] Fixed: Clicking a sticker now properly highlights it.  
[*] Fixed: Bought stickers not appearing on top of older ones.  
[*] Fixed: Full 20/20 sticker slots incorrectly showed “not enough honey” instead of “hive is full.”  
[*] Fixed: Hover info boxes sometimes flipped off-screen.  
[*] Fixed: A bug where bee overview window would sometimes show an empty page.  
[*] Fixed: Stickers could be moved outside the safe zone in edit mode.  
[*] Fixed: Delete Sticker button was active even when no sticker was selected.  
[/list]

Thanks again for all your feedback and support!

notes.title: Time Is Honey v1.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Time is Honey v1.5 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Bee presents were giving too much love as a reward

notes.title: Time Is Honey v1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Time is Honey v1.4 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Stickers placed at the bottom of your hive can now be moved properly!
[*]Improved: Holding the sell button while opening bee packs now takes less time!
[*]Fixed: The "Medieval Hive" was incorrectly labeled as "Medieval Pack" in the hives shop.
[*]Fixed: Two missing accessories have been restored! You can now get the Heart Cloud (from the Cute Accessory Pack) and the Egg Hat (from the Funny Accessory Pack) as intended.
[*]Changed: The "Open 10,000 Packs" achievement requirement has been reduced to 3,000 packs!
[*]Fixed: Opening presents from bees no longer gives more card packs than intended.
[*]Fixed: When opening a Present Bee Pack with more than 27 bees in your hive (out of 30 max), bees in the pack will no longer overwrite your existing bees.
[/list]

Thank you all so much for supporting the game!

notes.title: Time Is Honey v1.2 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]🐝 Time is Honey v1.2 Update 🐝[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added: Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese, French, German, Russian, and Spanish. Please note that the localization is still a work in progress, as machine translation has been used. It will be improved with your feedback in future updates.
[*] To prevent accidental deletions, you now need to hold the button for 1 second to sell a bee for 1 honey while opening a bee pack.
[*] The maximum level for food upgrades has been increased from 11 to 13!
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where the “Not Enough Honey” and “Max Level Reached” texts in the shop would occasionally be swapped.
[/list]

notes.title: Time Is Honey v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Time is Honey v1.1 Update[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
- [b]Discard While Opening Packs[/b]: You can now discard a bee for 1 honey directly while opening packs, so you don’t have to go back and find it in your hive if you plan to sell it.
- [b]Increased Golden Bee Chances[/b]: The chances for Golden Bees have been increased from 0.36% to 0.50% per card in standard 3-card Bee Packs.
- [b]Clearer Prices in Shop[/b]: Prices now display commas to make large numbers easier to read and less confusing.
- [b]Menu Page Memory[/b]: When you exit the Hive or Bee overview menus, your position will now be saved.
- [b]New Shortcuts[/b]:
  - [b]Q[/b] and [b]E[/b] to navigate back and forward through your hives.
  - [b]A[/b] and [b]D[/b] to navigate back and forward through your bees (If no bee is selected, it selects the first one automatically).
  - [b]Shift+V[/b] to quickly sell all filtered bees (with confirmation).
  - [b]Shift+B[/b] to quickly sell all baby bees (with confirmation).
- [b]Baby Bee Feeding[/b]: Added a toggle button so that only baby bees will go for the food.
- [b]Accessory Collection Menu[/b]: A new collection menu has been added where you can see which accessories you’ve unlocked and which ones you’re still missing.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where pressing space to rename a bee or hive also turned Auto Feed on or off.
- Bees that hit level 30 while selected will now properly update from level 29 without needing to reselect them.
- The hide/show hive feature was confusing some players, who thought it removed hives. This has now been made clearer.

[h2]Achievement Bug[/h2]
- Many of you reported issues with achievements. I’ve looked into it and corrected several errors. However, I can’t guarantee it’s fully resolved, as in the last update, it worked flawlessly on my Steam but not for others. Please test it out and let me know if it's fixed for you.

notes.title: Time is Honey v1.0b Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[center][b][h1]🐝 Time is Honey v1.0b Patch Notes 🐝[/h1][/b][/center]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]High Tier Golden Bees now have a larger penalty for being in the wrong hive. Tier 1 starts at -10% h/h, increasing by -5% for each next tier.
[*]While opening Bee Packs or Accessory Packs, you can now check drop chances at the top left corner.
[*]You can now turn Auto Food On/Off using the "Space" key.
[*]The game no longer minimizes while alt-tabbing in Fullscreen mode.
[*]Accessory Packs now have the same x1, x2, and x5 options as Bee Packs to open multiple packs at once.
[*]Added categories to the Encyclobeedia so you don't have to scroll all the way down to check bees from higher-priced hives.
[*]You can now hide hives in your hive list.
[*]The info box now has a bit of transparency.
[*]The demo to full version dialog now appears before loading, with a clearer message.
[*]Bees food hitboxes have been increased by 2x, making it a bit easier to feed them!
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Selling multiple bees will no longer hurt your ears!
[*]The tutorial box now has the same transparency as in the demo version.
[*]Fixed a bug where the hive list didn't update when you sold a hive.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game still detected input even when it wasn't focused.
[*]Fixed a bug where the info box stayed open after closing the current window.
[*]Hive and Bee Rename buttons now play the correct sounds on click.
[*]Fixed a bug where certain players couldn't open a free pack at the start of the game.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Food Rate Upgrade did nothing.
[/list]
